title: Practice portal — hovers, number input and notifications
context: Three more training pages of the practice portal (Hovers, Inputs, Notification Message). UI only. The notification copy has not been finalised by Content (story.md#L19).
actors: user of the practice portal (anonymous visitor)

sourcesRead.contributes: context (L19), AC-1..AC-3 (L23-L25), open question on auto-dismiss (L29); no attachments (L33)

acceptanceCriteria.text: On the Hovers page (/hovers), hovering over a user's avatar reveals that user's caption, "name: user<N>" for the N-th avatar, and a "View profile" link.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: **AC-1**: On the Hovers page (`/hovers`), hovering over a user's avatar reveals that user's caption, "name: user<N>" for the N-th avatar, and a "View profile" link.
outcomes: hovering over the N-th avatar reveals the caption "name: user<N>" for that avatar
hovering over the N-th avatar reveals a "View profile" link for that avatar
the caption and the "View profile" link are revealed by the hover (not shown for that avatar before it is hovered)

acceptanceCriteria.text: On the Inputs page (/inputs), the number field accepts digits (typing 42 leaves the value 42), and non-numeric characters cannot be entered (typing abc leaves the field empty).
acceptanceCriteria.quote: **AC-2**: On the Inputs page (`/inputs`), the number field accepts digits (typing `42` leaves the value 42), and non-numeric characters cannot be entered (typing `abc` leaves the field empty).
outcomes: typing 42 into the number field leaves the value 42
typing abc into the number field leaves the field empty

acceptanceCriteria.text: On the Notification Message page (/notification_message_rendered), clicking "Click here" shows an appropriate notification to the user.
acceptanceCriteria.quote: **AC-3**: On the Notification Message page (`/notification_message_rendered`), clicking "Click here" shows an appropriate notification to the user.
outcomes: after clicking "Click here" a notification is shown to the user

gaps.element: What counts as "an appropriate notification" in AC-3 (its text/copy, type or tone): the story gives no expected content, and L19 says Content has not finalised the notification copy yet. Marked non-blocking because the literal part can still be evaluated; it is the first question for the user/PO.
